info.description:
### Api documentation for **Vendors**. By **Noor**.

**Authentication**:

For integration with servers of Vendors, **Noor** will provide static token which is expected to be sent in **X-Auth** header in each request. Examples of this can be found in any request.

### **Timezone**:

Noor works in standard UTC timezone, meaning all date and time values returned by Noor is returned in UTC.

### **Language**:

Validation messages and certain names will be provided in **Uzbek** language by default. If you wish to receive them in different languages please provide language in **Accept-Language** header. Possible values: **en, ru, uz**. If incorrect value is passed to that header, Noor will take **uz** as default value.

### **Webhook:**

If Noor is provided wiith webhook url. Vendors' servers will receive updates on orders programmatically. Server will send updates to vendors URL through POST request with the same body as the response of create order endpoint. It triggers every time stage/status of any order changes.

### **Notes**:

For documentation on specific groups, please open corresponding request or folder documentation.

If you receive 400 Bad request error and not validation, there is a good chance types of certain values are incorrect. If Noor is expecting integer and receives string for example, it will throw 400 error.

Validation of all inputs can be obtained by making a request to set endpoint.

request.description:
Reorder endpoint lets you **search** for couriers for the **same** order again without having to create **another** order.  
  
It **only works**, if the order has been **cancelled** or courier was previously **not found**.

Update endpoint lets you change locations, addresses, production information, comments...

It only works if the order is **active**. Otherwise, you will get **order.is.closed** error.

Also, it will not update locations of points that have already been **visited** by courier.

item.description:
### **Possible Stages**:

``` go
const (
    StageNew                          = 1
    StageEstimating                   = 2
    StageReadyForPayment              = 3
    StageScheduled                    = 4
    StagePerformerLookUp              = 5
    StagePerformerDraft               = 6
    StagePerformerFound               = 7
    StagePickUpArrived                = 8
    StageReadyForPickUpConfirmation   = 9
    StagePickedUp                     = 10
    StageDeliveryArrived              = 11
    StageReadyForDeliveryConfirmation = 12
    StagePayWaiting                   = 13
    StageDelivered                    = 14
    StageDeliveredFinish              = 15
    StageReturning                    = 16
    StageReturnArrived                = 17
    StageReadyForReturnConfirmation   = 18
    StageReturned                     = 19
    StageReturnedFinish               = 20
    StageCancelledByTaxi              = 21
    StageCancelled                    = 22
    StageCancelledWithPayment         = 23
    StageCancelledWithItemsOnHand     = 24
    StageFailed                       = 25
    StageEstimatingFailed             = 26
    StagePerformerNotFound            = 27
    StageCancelledOutOfZone           = 28
    StageCancelledOutOfRange          = 29
)

 ```

### **Payment Types**:

``` go
const (
    PaymentTypeCard    = "CARD"
    PaymentTypeCash    = "CASH"
    PaymentTypeBalance = "BALANCE"
)

 ```

Payments can be accomplished through **CARD**, **CASH** and **BALANCE**. In case of balance, vendors can fill their balance beforehand and use that balance. In case of cash, delivery price will be taken from end client. And in case of card, the vendors card will be queired for suffitient funds right away and will be charged only after the delivery is finished.

**  
Additionals**:**Product information is not required, but if provided, it should be duplicated both for origin and destination points. This is needed to let couriers know which products needs to dropped off at which point.  
**

If _**delivery.product_paid**_ is set to _**true**_, Noor will not interact with product price. It will assume that price for product is already paid. Otherwise, Noor will get product money from end client.

Equipment information can be different in _**DEV**_ and _**PROD**_ environments. **However** ,they are **NOT** subject to change. The same can be said about product types.

  
Endpoints:

  
Eval - lets you get pricing, distance and ETA information before creating the actual order. Vendor is not charged for it.  
  
Reorder - if courier is not found for order, or the order has been cancelled prior, this endpoint lets you trigger the search for couriers again without having to create another order.
